# Top Creative Nails

> Top Creative Nails is a nail salon at 830 Mayfield Rd, Suite 500, Grand Prairie, TX 75052. It offers acrylic full sets and fills, dip powder, gel and classic manicures, pedicures in massage spa chairs, French tips, custom nail art, nail repair (including redos of sets done elsewhere), eyebrow waxing and kids polish. Walk-ins are welcome.

## Current Status (2026)
Open six days a week (closed Sunday). Appointments by phone at (972) 264-2744 or by Facebook message; walk-ins welcome.

## Services
### Manicures
- Classic manicure: Shape, cuticle care, hand massage and your choice of regular polish. (https://topcreativenails.com/services/classic-manicure/)
- Gel manicure: Manicure finished with LED-cured gel color for a glossy, chip-resistant finish. (https://topcreativenails.com/services/gel-manicure/)

### Pedicures
- Pedicure: Soak in a spa chair, nail and cuticle care, callus smoothing, massage and polish. (https://topcreativenails.com/services/pedicure/)

### Nail enhancements
- Acrylic nails: Full sets and fills in any length and shape: coffin, almond, stiletto, square. (https://topcreativenails.com/services/acrylic-nails/)
- Dip powder nails: Durable powder color, with or without added length. No UV lamp needed. (https://topcreativenails.com/services/dip-powder-nails/)
- French tip nails: Classic white tips, deep French, colored tips or a crystal accent. (https://topcreativenails.com/services/french-tip-nails/)

### Nail art and repair
- Nail art and designs: Hand-painted designs, marble, animal print, glitter, chrome and rhinestones. (https://topcreativenails.com/services/nail-art/)
- Nail repair and redo: Broken nail fixes, and rescues for sets that went wrong somewhere else. (https://topcreativenails.com/services/nail-repair/)

### Waxing
- Eyebrow waxing: Quick brow shaping with wax while you are in for nails. (https://topcreativenails.com/services/eyebrow-waxing/)

### Kids
- Kids manicure and polish: A gentle polish change or mini manicure for kids visiting with a parent. (https://topcreativenails.com/services/kids-nails/)

Pricing depends on length, shape and design; call (972) 264-2744 for current prices.

## FAQ
- Q: Where is Top Creative Nails?
  A: We are at 830 Mayfield Rd, Suite 500, Grand Prairie, TX 75052. Get directions and hours.
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Thursday 10 AM to 7 PM, Friday and Saturday 9 AM to 7 PM. We are closed on Sunday.
- Q: Do you take walk-ins?
  A: Yes. Walk-ins are welcome during open hours. The salon can get busy, especially on weekends, so call ahead at (972) 264-2744 if you want a set time.
- Q: How do I book an appointment?
  A: Call us at (972) 264-2744 or send a message on Facebook. See all the ways to book.
- Q: What services do you offer?
  A: Acrylic nails (full sets and fills), dip powder, gel and classic manicures, pedicures, French tips, nail art, nail repair, eyebrow waxing and kids polish.
- Q: Can you fix nails that were done at another salon?
  A: Yes. Clients regularly come to us after a set or design went wrong somewhere else, and we rebuild it the way they wanted. See nail repair and redo.
- Q: How much does a full set cost?
  A: Prices depend on the service, length, shape and how much design you add. Call (972) 264-2744 or ask at the front desk for today's price before we start.
- Q: Can I bring my kids?
  A: Yes. Kids can get a polish change or a mini manicure while you get your nails done. See kids manicure and polish.
- Q: Do you do eyebrow waxing?
  A: Yes. Eyebrow waxing is a quick add-on to any manicure or pedicure.
- Q: Can I bring a photo of the design I want?
  A: Please do. Show your tech a photo or screenshot and we will match it. Browse our nail gallery for ideas, or follow us on Instagram at @thetopcreativenails.

## Area Served
Grand Prairie, Arlington, Mansfield, Cedar Hill, Dallas, Texas
